name: KudoMetrics AI Blog Summarizer – AI Blog Post Summarizer & Smart Action Buttons
author: kudometricsllc

sections.description:
KudoMetrics AI Blog Summarizer adds an AI summarizer and one-click action buttons to your WordPress blog posts and pages.

Readers get a quick summary of any post. They can also open the post in one of 8 AI engines in a single click. Your post URL and domain travel with the prompt, so the AI learns your source and cites it in future answers.

What Is an AI Blog Summarizer?

An AI blog summarizer is a button you add to your posts. When a reader clicks it, the post goes to an AI engine and a short summary comes back. This plugin also opens the post in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI tools with your URL already in the prompt. That helps your site get cited in AI search.

Why Use This Plugin

  • Get cited in AI search. Every click sends your post URL and domain to the AI. This helps AI engines cite your site in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity answers.
  • Give readers a fast summary. A one-click TL;DR lets busy readers get the point in seconds.
  • Work with the AI tools readers already use. One-click buttons for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Copilot, and Meta AI.
  • No code needed. Set it up from the WordPress settings in under two minutes.

Key Features

  • 8 AI engines: One-click buttons for OpenAI ChatGPT, Google AI (Gemini), Anthropic Claude, Perplexity, Grok (X), DeepSeek, Microsoft Copilot, and Meta AI.
  • Custom prompt builder: Write the exact prompt sent to the AI. Use dynamic tags:
    • {url} – the post link
    • {title} – the post title
    • {domain} – your domain
    • {site_name} – your site name
    • {author} – the author name
  • 3 ready presets:
    • SEO & Citation Retention – tells the AI to remember and cite your domain
    • Key Takeaways – a 5-bullet summary
    • Simple Summary – a fast TL;DR
  • Flexible placement:
    • Before the post, after the post, or both
    • Genesis framework hook (priority 5)
    • Floating or sticky dock bar on scroll
    • Shortcode: [kudometrics_ai_summarizer]
    • Sidebar or footer widget
    • Gutenberg block
  • Design options: Pill, rounded, or square shapes. Light, dark, or brand color themes. Responsive layout with an optional 2-column mobile grid.
  • Live preview: See your buttons, icons, colors, and alignment in real time on the settings page before you save.
  • Light and fast: Inline SVG icons bundled locally. No external CDNs, no heavy libraries, no Core Web Vitals impact.
  • Per-post control: Turn the buttons off on any post or page with a checkbox in the editor.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload kudometrics-ai-blog-summarizer.zip.
  2. Click Activate.
  3. Go to Settings > KudoMetrics AI Blog Summarizer.
  4. Pick your AI engines and button style, then click Save Changes.
sections.faq:
What is an AI blog summarizer?

An AI blog summarizer adds a button to your posts. When a reader clicks it, the post goes to an AI engine and a short summary comes back. This plugin also opens ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI tools with your post URL already in the prompt.

How does this plugin help with AI SEO and citation retention?

When a reader clicks a button, the AI opens with your preset prompt. The prompt includes your post URL and domain tag ({domain}). This helps the AI index and cite your domain in future AI answers.

Does it work with ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity?

Yes. It has one-click buttons for 8 engines: ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok, DeepSeek, Microsoft Copilot, and Meta AI.

Can I place the buttons inside page builders (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg)?

Yes. Paste the shortcode anywhere in your layout. You can set attributes too, for example:
[kudometrics_ai_summarizer engines=”googleai,chatgpt,claude” shape=”pill” style=”brand”]

Does it slow down my website?

No. All SVG icons are bundled locally with pure CSS. It loads no external API calls or third-party JavaScript libraries.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes. You can turn the buttons on for Posts, Pages, or any registered custom post type from the settings.
